issue.title: In-sheet record value editing inside the Live Preview widget

task_type_fields.proposal: Let a record's field stages open inline in the record sheet under the H1 position (inside the CM6 widget and Reading view) instead of the Record Card modal, keeping one guarded bob writer, debounced previews, latched Enter, and Undo.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/record_card.md lists in-sheet editing inside the CM6 widget as out of scope; v1 edits only in the Record Card modal.

issue.creation_reason: The Record Card epic (bob-cli-ms) deferred in-sheet staging (editing values inside the CM6 record-sheet widget) and asked its land agent to file it.
